note: page header -- renders: logo, app name, search box label; user display name echoed in expandDisplayName is subtracted
settings navigation sidebar -- renders: fixed settings section names (Personal, Sharing, Security, Activity, Passwords, About, etc.)
avatar settings section -- renders: profile picture heading, upload/select buttons, instruction text; user-uploaded avatar image in avatardiv is subtracted
display name form -- renders: 'Full name' label; entry field value is user input, subtracted
recovery email form -- renders: 'Email' heading, set button, operator instruction text; entry value is user input, subtracted
groups section -- renders: 'Groups' heading and description text; group names are admin/operator-defined, not user-generated
password change form -- renders: 'Password' heading, field labels, strength indicator, set button; password entry fields are user input, subtracted
language selector -- renders: fixed closed set of language names defined by the platform
email notifications settings -- renders: heading, description paragraphs, combo box with fixed sending options (Never/As soon as possible/Sending daily summary)
federated file sharing settings -- renders: heading, description text, social sharing buttons, federated ID (admin-assigned username and server URL), add-to-website button
clients download section -- renders: heading, desktop/mobile client download links, description text, setup wizard button
version info section -- renders: version heading, documentation/changelog links, version strings; all operator-authored
